releases.notes:
**This version breaks the generic CCA module format**

This is a revision of the CCA module format to support multiple components per module. Use the new `.from` method if you want just one in code.

In data:

```
// data/switchy/switchy_cca_modules/lanyard.json
// creates the module switchy:lanyard (namespace folder + filename)
{
  "default": true,
  "importable": "ALLOWED",
  "ifModsLoaded": ["lanyard"],
  "components": ["lanyard:profiles"]
}
```


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sisby-folk/switchy/compare/v1.8.0...v1.8.1
